purpose: Compose one canonical Hero detail record from frozen Hero Stage 4 and Stage 5 outputs without reopening their source semantics, while preserving the parallel Stage B ownership boundary for Hero <-> Exclusive Equipment.

optionalParallelInputs.policy: Stage 6-1 must not block while Stage B is still in progress. When the shared Stage B index appears, Stage 6-1 must require exact parity between the frozen Stage 5-2 equipmentId and the shared relation byHero result.

shape.shared.soldiersById: single normalized Soldier presentation dictionary copied from frozen Stage 5-3
shape.parallelDependencies: explicit Stage B adoption state; no inferred ownership

recordContract.header: full frozen Stage 5-5 record exact-copy except duplicate heroId

normal.soldierModifiers: Stage 4 Hero-owned soldier modifier block exact-copy

recordContract.exclusiveEquipment: Stage 5-2 exclusiveEquipment exact-copy; ownership is not re-derived here
recordContract.soldiers: Stage 5-3 byHeroId[String(heroId)] exact-copy as canonical soldierIds

normalizationPolicy.soldiers: Do not duplicate Soldier presentation metadata into every Hero record. Keep canonical soldierIds per Hero and preserve the single frozen Stage 5-3 soldiersById dictionary under shared.soldiersById.
normalizationPolicy.header: Stage 5-5 remains the presentation/header authority. Stage 6-1 does not synthesize localization or asset paths.
normalizationPolicy.exclusiveEquipment: Stage 5-2 remains the frozen display snapshot during parallel Stage B work. Stage B is the semantic owner of the final shared ownership relation.

exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.semanticOwner: shared Hero <-> Exclusive Equipment relation layer defined by B-0
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.currentBehavior: Copy the frozen Stage 5-2 block. Do not read ConfigDataEquipmentInfo, names, icons, restrictions, PathType, or ordering to derive ownership.
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.whenStageBArtifactMissing: Record PENDING_B_STAGE_NON_BLOCKING and allow Stage 6-1 structural completion.
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.whenStageBArtifactPresent: Require exact by-Hero equipment ID parity with frozen Stage 5-2. Any mismatch is a hard error; the Stage B index becomes the relation evidence used by downstream final admission.
exclusiveEquipmentParallelBoundary.finalAdmissionBoundary: A later Stage 6 final/site-admission gate must require shared Stage B relation adoption before declaring the complete Hero data pipeline site-frozen.

forbiddenWork: Recalculate Hero-exclusive Equipment ownership from ConfigData in Stage 6-1
Infer exclusive Equipment ownership from names, descriptions, icons, restrictions, PathType, IDs, or release order
Invent Korean localization, acquisition metadata, release dates, or asset delivery paths
hardValidationRules: Hero Stage 5 integration checkpoint must be PASS / STAGE_5_COMPLETE with zero blockers and zero hard errors
Hero master must contain exactly 267 unique heroIds
Stage 4, Stage 5-1, Stage 5-2, Stage 5-4 and Stage 5-5 must each contain exactly one record for every canonical heroId
Stage 5-3 byHeroId must contain exactly all 267 canonical Hero keys
Every Stage 5-3 soldierId must exist in Stage 5-3 soldiersById
No per-Hero Soldier membership is recalculated or filtered in Stage 6-1
Every output Hero record must preserve the exact source blocks assigned by this contract
If Stage B byHero exists, its Hero keys and equipment IDs must exactly match frozen Stage 5-2 ownership presence/identity
Duplicate, missing, extra or noncanonical Hero IDs are hard errors
nonBlockingInheritedReview: Stage 5-3 pending Korean Soldier display names remain presentation REVIEW only
Stage 5-5 skins with omitted GetPathType remain UNENCODED by policy
Stage 5-5 Korean localization and web-delivery asset conversion remain downstream presentation work
Stage B relation adoption is nonblocking for 6-1 only while the parallel relation stage is still in progress
completion: Stage 6-1 is COMPLETE when all 267 canonical Hero records are composed from frozen Stage 4/5 outputs with zero structural mismatches and zero semantic re-derivation. Pending Stage B adoption is recorded explicitly and deferred to the final Hero site-admission boundary.
